content.title: Kylie Jenner Has Major Bieber Fever in Explicit Justin Bieber Tank Top Ahead of His First Solo Coachella Set
content.text: Bieber will make his debut headlining performance on Saturday, April 11 Updated on April 10, 2026 05:00PM EDT Kylie Jenner rocks shirt with explicit phot oof Justin Bieber ahead of his Coachella 2026 performance. Credit : Kylie Jenner/Instagram; Kevin Mazur/Getty NEED TO KNOW Kylie Jenner is showing her support for Justin Bieber at CoachellaThe reality star rocked a tank top featuring an NSFW photo of the singer as seen in a new Instagram postBieber will return to Coachella on April 11 for his first solo set at the festival since appearing in 2024 Kylie Jenner is feeling like one less lonely girl. The beauty mogul, 28, touched down in Indio, Calif., this week for Coachella, ready to party at one of the biggest music festivals of the year. And if you couldn't already tell, she's ready to burn up with Bieber fever. On April 10, the Kardashians star posted an Instagram photo of herself wearing a blinged-out green tank top featuring an NSFW photo of a tatted Justin Bieber in sunglasses and holding up his middle fingers. She can also be seen with two clear bags of what appears to be clothing from the singer's fashion label SKYLRK. Kylie Jenner wears Justin Bieber T-shirt at Coachella. Kylie Jenner/Instagram The brand, which Bieber launched in July 2025, is hosting the SKYLRK Oasis, which will give festival-goers the chance to shop its exclusive Coachella collection, and it certainly looks like Jenner got first dibs! Related Stories Jenner has supported Bieber, who will perform his first dedicated Coachella set on Saturday, April 11, in her other content. On her way to the desert, she posted a TikTok video about how she was most excited to see Bieber on stage. Justin Bieber performing at the 2026 Grammys in February. Kevin Winter/Getty This weekend's set will be the first major appearance that Bieber, 32, has made since he performed at the 2026 Grammys back in February. (He has performed a couple smaller shows in L.A. in the lead-up to Coachella.) That night, he sang his nominated song "Yukon" in nothing but a pair of SKYLRK boxer shorts. His topless appearance revealed what was believed to be a new tattoo of Bieber's wife Hailey, who walked the carpet with the singer earlier. Bieber made a surprise appearance at Coachella in 2019 with Ariana Grande and then again in 2024 with Tems, but this year is his first with a dedicated set at the festival. Last fall, Bieber let fans in on his preparation through streaming platform Twitch. Videos shared by the dad of one showed him and his crew putting together the upcoming show. At the time, a source revealed that it was his way of showing fans his dedication to the event.
